payload.description_html:
Fig. 42. Coelophysis bauri Cope. Third or fourth cervical vertebra; a from right side,

b from below, showing cast of big internal hole together with neural canal connecting both extremities of the injured vertebra. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 226 "third cervical ".) Fig. 43. Coelophysis bauri. Left aspect of fourth or fifth cervical vertebra. X 1/2. Fig. 44. ?Coelophysis bauri. Ninth or tenth cervical vertebra; a left aspect, b anterior aspect, c transverse section. X 1/2. Fig. 45. Coelophysis bauri. Anterior dorsal vertebra with left transverse process and left prezygapophysis; a left, b front aspect. X 1/2. Fig. 46. Coelophysis bauri. Dorsal vertebra, centrum, two views. X 1/2. (Type: Cope, 1. c. 1887, p. 223 "C. longicollis"). Fig. 47. Coelophysis bauri. Sacrum, two and one-half anterior sacrals; a fourth one

was probably in existence. Left aspect. X I.
